---
title: "Lagos · SURGO × Manitoba"
output:
  html_document:
    template: ../common/report.html
    theme: null
    mathjax: null
    self_contained: false
    keep_md: false
    pandoc_args: ["--wrap=none"]
params:
  input_zip: !r Sys.getenv("SURGO_MANITOBA_INPUT_ZIP", "")
  work_dir: "output/report_build"
  cache_dir: "data/cache"
  join_dir: ""
  python: !r Sys.getenv("SURGO_MANITOBA_PYTHON", "python3")
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
source("../common/pipeline.R")
project_root <- normalizePath("../..", mustWork = TRUE)
use_project_library(project_root)
```

```{r calculate-and-verify, include=FALSE}
# All definitions, weighted summaries, models and verification are in the R
# scripts in this country directory. Python formats the saved aggregate results.
# A blank join_dir builds the original join modules directly from input_zip.
report <- build_country_report("lagos", project_root, params$input_zip,
  params$work_dir, params$cache_dir, params$join_dir, params$python)
```

```{r report, results='asis'}
cat("```{=html}\n")
cat(readLines(report$fragment, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), sep = "\n")
cat("\n```\n")
```
